dropped_at_resolution.detail: API model-info returns gated='auto' (not 'manual'), and metadata (siblings/blobs) IS visible without auth. However authenticated config.json fetch (Authorization: Bearer $HF_TOKEN) returns HTTP 403 ('Access to model huihui-ai/Qwen3-4B-abliterated is restricted and you are not in the authorized list'). So despite gated='auto', this token's account has not been granted/auto-approved access, and no weight or config file can be downloaded -> functionally gated exactly like 'manual' for this pipeline.
